name: Chiseiko Essential Swatches for WooCommerce
author: Chiseiko LLC

sections.description:
Chiseiko Essential Swatches turns plain WooCommerce variation dropdowns into beautiful, clickable color, image, text, and button swatches — on single product pages and shop, category, and tag archives. Shoppers see their options at a glance, pick the right variation in one click, and add to cart faster.

Lightweight & Fast

Speed matters for conversions. Built for performance from day one:
* Vanilla JavaScript Core: Built in vanilla JS with no jQuery code of its own (only hooking into unavoidable WooCommerce core events).
* Conditional Asset Loading: Scripts and styles load only on product and shop pages — and only on the kinds of page where you have swatches switched on.
* Batch AJAX: Archive swatch data is fetched via a single batched request per page, rather than punishing your server with one request per product.

The problem with default WooCommerce variations

Out of the box, WooCommerce hides every product variation behind a generic <select> dropdown. That quietly costs you sales:
* Customers can’t see the colors or styles you sell — they have to open a menu and read text.
* Available options stay hidden until the dropdown is opened, so shoppers miss variants.
* There’s no visual feedback on mobile, where dropdowns are slow and fiddly.
* Shop and category pages show no variation choices at all, so every selection means an extra page load.

How it works

Go to Products > Attributes and edit any global attribute. For each term, choose a swatch type (color, image, label, or radio) and configure it — or set a default swatch type on the attribute itself to turn every term into label or radio buttons in one step. Swatches appear automatically on every product that uses that attribute — no shortcodes or template edits required. The term editor shows a live preview as you work, groups its fields into sections, and shows only the fields for the swatch type you choose. Local (custom per-product) attributes render as text pills automatically. A short getting-started notice after activation points you to the right screens.

Switching from another swatch plugin

  • Automatic import — Switching from another swatch plugin? Supported: Variation Swatches for WooCommerce (by Emran Ahmed / GetWooPlugins, by CartFlows, by AovUp, or by RadiusTheme), WCBoost – Variation Swatches, Choosly by VillaTheme, Product Variation Swatches by ThemeHigh, YITH Color, Image & Label Variation Swatches, WPC Variation Swatches by WPClever, Swatchly, and WooCommerce’s own color / image attributes. The first time a store manager opens wp-admin after activation, your colors, images, label and radio attributes, and the overall swatch shape and size are copied across in the background. A notice shows what was imported.
  • Nothing is lost — The other plugin’s data is never changed, swatches you have already set up in Chiseiko are never overwritten, and one click on Undo removes everything the import added.
  • Stays in sync — While both plugins are active, changes made in the other plugin are copied across until you edit that term in Chiseiko. Every import, change and undo is listed in a sync history in the settings.
  • Check before you commit — The settings show a preview for each plugin found (how many swatches are ready, how many attributes, what is already imported), and an Import now button for anything left to bring across.
  • Swatches from plugins we don’t list — If your colors or images were saved by a plugin or custom setup Chiseiko does not know, Chiseiko finds them too and shows what it found. Nothing from these is ever imported on its own: you check the numbers and press Import now, and it can be undone.
  • Your choice — Turn off the automatic import or the syncing at any time in the settings.
  • Safe to remove the old plugin — Deactivating or deleting the other plugin never changes your Chiseiko swatches, even when it deletes its own data.

Swatch types (all four included free)

  • Color Swatches — Pick any hex color for each attribute term.
  • Image Swatches — Upload a thumbnail from the Media Library.
  • Text Pills — Styled labels for attributes without a visual representation.
  • Radio Buttons — Round radio indicators with label text for simple selections.
  • Attribute-wide Defaults — Show every term of an attribute (such as Size) as label or radio buttons without editing each term; individual terms can still set their own type.

Choose where swatches appear

  • Page switches — Turn swatches on or off separately for product pages, the shop page, category pages, tag pages, other product taxonomy pages such as brands, related and upsell products, and product blocks on other pages. Everything is on by default.
  • Clean fallback — A page you switch off looks exactly as it would without the plugin: WooCommerce’s own dropdowns on product pages, plain product cards and buttons elsewhere, and none of the plugin’s swatch files loaded.

Look & feel

  • Global Shape & Size — Circle, rounded square, or square swatches at any size from 24 to 64 px. With rounded or square, label swatches widen to fit their text. Touch screens keep comfortable 44 px tap targets.
  • Tooltips — Term names appear on hover and keyboard focus.
  • Attribute Row Alignment — Keep each attribute name aligned with its row of swatches, whatever your theme does by default.

Single product page

  • Instant Gallery Preview — The product gallery updates the moment a swatch is clicked.
  • Smart Inventory UX — Out-of-stock swatches are visually dimmed (not hidden), so customers always see available options.
  • Layout Options — Inline, accordion (collapsible), overflow (“Show more”), or slider layouts.
  • Mobile Auto-Scroll — Auto-scrolls to the gallery after selection so mobile users see the updated image.
  • Accessible — Full ARIA support for keyboard navigation and screen readers.

Shop & archive pages

  • Interactive Archive Swatches — Clickable swatches on product cards so customers can preview variants directly from the catalog.
  • AJAX Add to Cart — An “Add to Cart” button appears right on the grid after selection.
  • Catalog Mode — Show only one attribute (like Color) on archives for a cleaner layout.
  • Related & Upsell Products — The same interactive swatches appear on related, upsell, and cross-sell product cards on product pages.

Free vs Pro

The free plugin is a complete swatch solution with no caps on the number of swatches, attributes, or products.

Upgrade to Chiseiko Essential Swatches Pro when you need advanced tools for a growing store:
* Linked Simple Products: Tie standalone simple products together into one swatch strip while keeping an indexable URL per variant.
* Advanced Styling: Custom shapes, gradients, tooltips, and out-of-stock display modes (cross-out / blur / hide).
* Swatch Filter Widget: Let shoppers filter your catalog by color or brand.
* Bulk Management: CSV Import/Export, Variable-to-Simple migration, and Auto-Assign Images.
* Per-Product Carry-Over: When you switch from WCBoost, Swatchly, Variation Swatches by CartFlows or YITH Premium, Pro can adopt their per-product swatch settings as per-product overrides.
* Conversion Tools: Dynamic Price Sync, Attribute-Based Extra Fees, and a Sticky Mobile Add-to-Cart bar.
* Scale & Compatibility: AJAX Variation Override for large catalogs, Multilingual Sync (WPML/Polylang), and Quick View support.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chiseiko-essential-swatches folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce 8.0 or later is active.
  4. Go to Products > Attributes, edit an attribute, and configure swatch types for each term — or choose a default swatch type for the whole attribute.
  5. Switching from another swatch plugin (one of those listed in the Description, or WooCommerce’s own color swatches)? Your swatches are imported automatically — review the notice, then deactivate the old plugin when you are happy.
  6. Optionally configure settings (where swatches appear, layout, shape, size, tooltips) at WooCommerce > Settings > Chiseiko Essential Swatches Settings. The plugin’s row on the Plugins screen links straight there and to the built-in guide.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Chiseiko Essential Swatches requires WooCommerce 8.0 or later (tested up to WooCommerce 11.2.1).

Is it really free?

Yes. The free plugin includes all four swatch types, single-product and archive swatches, interactive archive swatches with AJAX add-to-cart, every layout mode, catalog mode, and mobile auto-scroll — with no caps on swatches, attributes, or products. Pro is an optional add-on for advanced features.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. All plugin-owned JavaScript is vanilla. Assets load only on product and shop pages. Archive swatch data is cached and served via a single batched AJAX endpoint to protect server performance.

Will it work with my theme?

Chiseiko Essential Swatches uses WooCommerce’s standard variation form hooks and does not override templates, so it is compatible with any properly built WooCommerce theme — including Classic themes, FSE block themes, and page builders (Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder).

Does it work with custom (local) product attributes?

Yes. Local attributes automatically render as text-pill swatches. To use color or image swatches, convert them to global attributes under Products > Attributes.

Can I show swatches on the shop and category pages?

Yes — they show there by default. Under “Where to Show Swatches” you can switch the shop, category, tag, and brand pages on or off separately. Turn on Interactive Archive Swatches to let customers preview variants and add to cart directly from product cards, or use Catalog Mode to show a single attribute for a cleaner grid.

Can I control the layout for products with many swatches?

Yes. Choose inline (default), accordion (collapsible panels per attribute), overflow (“Show N more” toggle), or slider. Accordion can be set to mobile-only, and the overflow limit is configurable.

Can I hide swatches on archive pages?

Yes. Uncheck those pages under “Where to Show Swatches” in the settings — the cards then look exactly as they do without the plugin. Developers can also return false from the chiseikoessw_surface_enabled filter for a page type, or from the chiseikoessw_render_loop_swatches filter to suppress a single product.

Can I keep WooCommerce’s dropdowns on product pages?

Yes. Uncheck “Product pages” under “Where to Show Swatches”. Product pages then show WooCommerce’s standard dropdowns and add the chosen variation to the cart as usual, while the shop and category pages can keep their swatches. This is useful when another plugin or your theme handles product-page swatches.

I already use another swatch plugin. Do I have to set everything up again?

No, if you use one of the swatch plugins listed in the Description, or WooCommerce’s own color / image attributes. Chiseiko copies your colors, images, label and radio attributes, and the swatch shape and size the first time a store manager opens wp-admin, and shows a notice with the counts. The other plugin’s data is not changed, and Undo in the notice (or under “Import From Another Swatch Plugin” in the settings) removes everything the import added. Images are matched to your media library; images stored on another site are never downloaded. Developers can import from the command line with wp chiseikoessw swatch-import and add other plugins with the chiseikoessw_swatch_sources filter.

Should I keep the old swatch plugin active?

Only while you check the result. As long as it is active, its changes are copied across (listed under “Sync history” in the settings) and both plugins may draw swatches, so deactivate it once your swatches look right. Its data stays in your database, so you can switch back at any time.

What happens to my swatches if I delete the old swatch plugin?

Nothing. Copying stops when the old plugin is deactivated, and deleting it — even when it removes its own data — leaves your Chiseiko swatches and settings exactly as they are. Deleting Chiseiko Essential Swatches likewise removes only its own data and never touches another plugin’s swatches or settings.

Will my old plugin’s data be changed?

No. Chiseiko only reads it. Your old plugin’s settings and swatch data stay exactly as they were, so you can switch back at any time. Undo removes only what the import added, and swatches you already set up in Chiseiko are never overwritten.

What if my old swatch plugin is not on your list?

Chiseiko also looks for colors and images saved on your attribute terms by plugins it does not know. If it finds some, the settings show a card with a preview. Nothing is imported until you check the numbers and press Import now, and you can undo it. If an attribute has more than one possible field, you choose which one holds your swatches. Images stored on another website are never downloaded.

Is the plugin translatable?

Yes. All strings use the chiseiko-essential-swatches text domain and are translation-ready.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • New: Redesigned swatch editor on attribute terms — a live preview of the swatch as you edit, fields grouped into sections, and only the fields for the chosen swatch type shown.
  • New: “Where to Show Swatches” settings — turn swatches on or off for product pages, the shop page, category pages, tag pages, other product taxonomy pages such as brands, related products, and product blocks on other pages. A page that is switched off keeps WooCommerce’s own dropdowns or product cards and loads none of the plugin’s swatch files. Everything stays on by default.
  • New: Switching from another swatch plugin — the plugins listed in the Description, and WooCommerce’s own color / image attributes — your colors, images, label and radio attributes, and swatch shape and size are imported automatically in the background, with a notice, a preview and an “Import now” button in the settings, a sync history, and one-click undo. The other plugin’s data is never changed and swatches you set up in Chiseiko are never overwritten. While both are active, the other plugin’s changes keep syncing until you edit the term in Chiseiko. A step guide on the import panel walks you through it: Found, pick the field, Import, check the result.
  • New: Per-product swatch settings are read from WCBoost, Swatchly, Variation Swatches by CartFlows and YITH Premium so Chiseiko Essential Swatches Pro can adopt them as per-product overrides. The other plugin’s data is never changed.
  • New: Import options — import automatically, and keep copying changes from the other plugin — both on by default. Chiseiko Essential Swatches Pro manages them on its Tools tab.
  • New: WP-CLI command wp chiseikoessw swatch-import (--dry-run, --status, --undo, --log, --source).
  • New: Swatches from a plugin Chiseiko does not know are found too — a field holding a color for every term, or images from your media library, is offered as “Unknown plugin (field …)”. It is never imported automatically: you preview it and press Import now, and it can be undone. When an attribute has more than one such field, nothing is imported until you choose.
  • Fix: Deleting the plugin on a multisite network now removes its data from every site, not only the main one.
  • Fix: An attribute’s default swatch type (label or radio) now follows a slug rename — and is removed with the attribute — when the change is made through the WooCommerce REST API or WP-CLI, not only on the Attributes screen.
  • Developers: chiseikoessw_swatch_sources filter to add import sources; chiseikoessw_swatch_import_enabled filter for the import options; chiseikoessw_swatch_import_term (fires for imports and syncs), chiseikoessw_swatch_import_undo (term IDs, before the undo deletes) and chiseikoessw_swatch_import_done actions; chiseikoessw_swatch_discovery_enabled and chiseikoessw_swatch_discovery_excluded_keys filters for auto-discovery, chiseikoessw_swatch_discovery_row_limit filter (tests and very large stores), and chiseikoessw_swatch_term_data filter to change a term’s swatch for one product.
  • Fix: Swatch strips on product blocks outside the shop pages (for example the home page or the 404 page) are now styled.

1.1.0

  • New: Attribute-wide default swatch type — show every term of an attribute (such as Size) as label or radio buttons in one step. Individual terms can still choose their own type.
  • New: Global swatch shape (circle, rounded square, square) for color, image, and label swatches on product pages and shop, category, and related-product cards — with rounded square or square, label swatches widen to fit their text. Global swatch size (24–64 px) on desktop; touch screens keep 44 px tap targets.
  • New: Getting-started notice after activation that points to the attribute and settings screens.
  • New: Settings and Guide links on the plugin’s row in the Plugins screen.
  • New: An occasional, dismissible review request, shown only on the plugin’s own screens to store managers — for WordPress.org, or for Pro on chiseikotech.com when Pro is installed.
  • New: “Customizing Swatches” chapter in the built-in guide — tested CSS and PHP examples, including how to let long labels fit their swatch.
  • Fix: Shop and category swatch strips (and related-product cards) are laid out correctly — spaced, aligned, and limited to two rows — when interactive archive swatches are off, which is the default.
  • Fix: The archive swatch alignment setting (left, center, right) now applies with the default inline layout.
  • Fix: Long swatch labels no longer make one product card wider than the others in grid themes such as Astra. Labels too long for a card end in “…”, and the full name stays in the tooltip and screen-reader label.
  • Fix: Links in the built-in guide no longer point to chapters that only ship with Pro.
  • Maintenance: tested with WordPress 7.1.4 and WooCommerce 11.2.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Four swatch types: Color, Image, Label, Radio Button.
  • Instant gallery preview (single attribute image preview).
  • Interactive archive swatches with AJAX add-to-cart.
  • Batch AJAX endpoint for archive variation data.
  • Catalog Mode for clean archive layouts.
  • Accordion, overflow, and slider swatch layouts.
  • Mobile auto-scroll to gallery on variant selection.
  • Smart Inventory UX with out-of-stock dimming and auto-select.
  • Conditional asset loading (product and shop pages only).
  • Full ARIA accessibility support.
  • Variation direct links (URL query parameter pre-selection).
  • Developer hooks: chiseikoessw_swatch_types, chiseikoessw_swatch_button_classes, chiseikoessw_swatch_button_html, chiseikoessw_swatch_group_html, chiseikoessw_render_loop_swatches, plus action hooks.

short_description: Lightweight WooCommerce variation swatches. Replace plain dropdowns with fast, visual color, image, and text swatches on product and shop pages.
